description: Mesui wears an opaque muted teal floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold cloud and geometric woven motifs cover the teal outer fabric and edge the neckline, cuffs, waist and long skirt sides. A cream patterned underdress forms the central bodice and lower-front panel. A decorated teal sash with small round ornaments and tassels sits at the waist. A brown shoulder wrap with matching teal and gold borders rests around her forearms. Long modest drop earrings and a round brooch near her left neckline provide ornaments. Brown embroidered flat shoes show under the hem. Her loose black hair is uncovered.
